title: Story pack: Decoded #9 is out (Test Calendar)
hook: Your 2027 plan says what you will post. Does it say what you will know?
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

Announces Decoded #9: Build a Test Calendar, Not a Content Calendar. Frame 1 is the issue title. Frame 2 compares the two calendars. Frame 3 is the poll. Frame 4 sends people to the issue with a link sticker.
alt_text: Four vertical story frames. Frame 1: Decoded #9, Build a Test Calendar, Not a Content Calendar, out today. Frame 2 compares a content calendar (what will we post, themes by week, counted in posts) with a test calendar (what will we know, one question a fortnight, counted in answers). Frame 3 is a poll: does your 2027 plan have a question in it? Frame 4 asks people to read Decoded #9 free.
cta: Tap the link sticker to read Decoded #9
